formats.export_name: Strategy Tester > Backtest tab > right-click > Report > HTML (older builds: 'Save as Report'). Default file name ReportTester-<login>.html. MT5 also writes PNG charts next to it with the same base name: <base>.png ('Balance graph'), <base>-hst.png, <base>-mfemae.png, <base>-holding.png. The same menu also offers 'Open XML (MS Office Excel 2007)', covered in its own entry.
formats.file_type: .html. As written by the terminal it is UTF-16 LE with a BOM (FF FE). Users and tools often re-save it as UTF-8, with or without a BOM, and both public real samples found on GitHub had already been converted to UTF-8. The file has no <meta charset> tag. DOCTYPE HTML 4.01 Transitional, <title>Strategy Tester Report</title>, <meta name="generator" content="strategy tester">.
formats.structure:
VERIFIED against two real reports (build 5640 and build 6033, from 2025-2026). The body holds two elements, each 13 columns wide. TABLE 1, header and statistics: - Row 1: 'Strategy Tester Report'. - Row 2: ' (Build NNNN)'. - Section-title row 'Settings', shaped . - Then label/value rows: . The labels, verbatim, are 'Expert:', 'Symbol:', 'Period:' (value like 'H1 (2024.01.01 - 2025.12.01)', which gives the test window), 'Inputs:' (first input row only; each later input row has an empty label and a value 'Name=Value'), 'Company:', 'Currency:', 'Initial Deposit:' (e.g. '10 000.00') and 'Leverage:' ('1:100'). - Then the section-title row 'Results'. Its rows alternate label/value pairs, , up to three pairs per row. Parse the table as: every td whose text ends in ':' is a label, and the next td's text is its value. - The labels, verbatim: History Quality:, Bars:, Ticks:, Symbols:, Total Net Profit:, Balance Drawdown Absolute:, Equity Drawdown Absolute:, Gross Profit:, Balance Drawdown Maximal:, Equity Drawdown Maximal:, Gross Loss:, Balance Drawdown Relative:, Equity Drawdown Relative:, Profit Factor:, Expected Payoff:, Margin Level:, Recovery Factor:, Sharpe Ratio:, Z-Score:, AHPR:, LR Correlation:, OnTester result:, GHPR:, LR Standard Error:, Total Trades:, Short Trades (won %):, Long Trades (won %):, Total Deals:, Profit Trades (% of total):, Loss Trades (% of total):, Largest profit trade:, Largest loss trade:, Average profit trade:, Average loss trade:, Maximum consecutive wins ($):, Maximum consecutive losses ($):, Maximal consecutive profit (count):, Maximal consecutive loss (count):, Average consecutive wins:, Average consecutive losses:, Correlation (Profits,MFE):, Correlation (Profits,MAE):, Correlation (MFE,MAE):, Minimal position holding time:, Maximal position holding time:, Average position holding time:. - Value formats: '7 025.85 (11.00%)', '14.23% (1 563.49)', '85 (100.00%)', '100% real ticks' or '99%' for History Quality, and 'H:MM:SS' for holding times. - Chart rows look like . TABLE 2, Orders then Deals: - Each section title is . For Deals the text is 'Deals'. - The next row is the column header, , whose cells are . - ORDERS header, verbatim: Open Time | Order | Symbol | Type | Volume (colspan=2) | Price | S / L | T / P | Time (colspan=2) | State | Comment. That is 11 cells spanning 13 columns. Row example: 2024.01.02 02:00:00 | 2 | XAUUSD | sell | '0.31 / 0.31' | '0.00' (market orders show 0.00 in the tester) | '' | '' | 2024.01.02 02:00:00 | filled | comment. - DEALS header, verbatim, 13 cells: Time | Deal | Symbol | Type | Direction | Volume | Price | Order | Commission | Swap | Profit | Balance | Comment. - Data rows are or , with plain cells. - The first deal is always the deposit: Type 'balance'; Symbol, Direction, Volume, Price and Order empty; Profit = the initial deposit; Balance = the initial deposit. - The last row of the table is an unlabeled totals row: followed by sum Commission, sum Swap, sum Profit of the non-balance deals, final Balance, and an empty cell. - There is NO Positions table in a tester report. HOW TO LOCATE THE TABLES: - (a) Preferred: find the as the header, then read data rows until the next section title or a row whose first cell is empty (the totals row). - (b) Language-agnostic fallback. Section titles and column names ARE localized to the terminal's UI language: a Chinese report uses 成交 for Deals, and a Russian tester writes the end-of-test comment 'окончание теста'. So also accept any header row with bgcolor="#E5F0FC" whose data rows have 13 cells and a 5th cell in {in, out, in/out, out by}, or a 4th cell equal to 'balance'. - Deal Type and Direction values appear to stay in English even in localized reports, since a parser for a Chinese report matches 'balance', 'in' and 'out' literally. Confidence in this is MEDIUM. - Spanish label strings could NOT be verified. Do not hard-code guessed Spanish names; use the structural fallback. PARSER NOTE: the repo has no lxml or bs4, so use stdlib html.parser. Real rows sometimes have unquoted attributes (align=right), and one sample contained a stray , so the parser must tolerate both.

formats.round_trip_reconstruction:
CELL VALUES
- Time is 'YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM:SS' in broker/server time. The file carries no timezone, so record the UTC assumption as DECLARED.
- Numbers use '.' as the decimal separator and a SPACE as the thousands separator ('10 000.00', '-1 527.72'; the two samples used U+0020). Strip U+0020, U+00A0 and U+202F before float(). Volume in an Orders cell looks like '0.31 / 0.31'.
- Type values: 'buy' or 'sell' for trades. 'balance' is a deposit or withdrawal. Other non-trade types exist in MT5 (credit, charge, correction, bonus, commission, interest, dividend, tax...), but their exact report text is NOT verified, so treat every Type outside {buy, sell} as a non-trade cash flow.
- Direction is the position event: 'in' opens or adds, 'out' closes or reduces, 'in/out' reverses (netting only: one fill closes the whole current position and opens the opposite one with the remainder), and 'out by' is close-by (hedging: two deals close two opposite positions).
- Type is the side of the FILL. A 'sell' 'out' closes a LONG, and a 'buy' 'out' closes a SHORT.
- Profit is gross price P&L in account currency and appears only on out, in/out and out by deals. Commission is charged on both legs (verified: the in deal's commission already reduces Balance). Swap appears on the closing deal.
- Deals carry NO position id. For the 'in' deal, Order equals the opening order ticket. For the 'out' deal, Order is the closing order's ticket.
- End-of-test forced closes have Comment 'end of test'. SL/TP closes have Comment 'sl <price>' or 'tp <price>' with no brackets in the tester (verified).
ALGORITHM, per symbol, deals in file order (already chronological):
- Keep a FIFO queue of open lots, each {side, vol_left, entry_price, entry_time, entry_comm_left}.
- On 'in': push a lot with side = long if Type is buy, else short. Its entry commission is the deal's Commission.
- On 'out' or 'out by': the closed side is the opposite of Type. Consume volume FIFO from lots of that side.
  - Each consumed slice emits one round trip: entry_time and entry_price from the lot; exit_time and exit_price from the deal; qty = the slice volume in lots; side.
  - pnl_gross = the deal's Profit allocated across slices by price-implied weight w_i = (exit - entry_i) * dir * vol_i. This is exact because one contract multiplier applies within one deal. If sum(w) = 0, fall back to volume weights.
  - Also add the deal's Swap and Commission pro rata by volume, plus the lot's entry commission pro rata by the consumed fraction.
  - Partial closes therefore become several round trips that share one entry.
- On 'in/out': first close the entire open opposite volume V as above (Profit belongs wholly to that close). Then push a new lot of side = Type with volume (deal volume - V). Split the deal's Commission by volume between the close and the new lot (ASSUMPTION).
- Net pnl of a round trip = allocated Profit + Swap + Commission.
- Hedging vs netting: the report does not state the margin mode (UNCERTAIN; the tester inherits it from the account or server). Infer hedging if 'out by' appears or if long and short lots of the same symbol are open at the same time. Infer netting if 'in/out' appears.
  - Under hedging, FIFO can mis-pair entries when an EA closes a non-oldest ticket. Per-deal money P&L stays exact, but per-trade entry price and holding time are approximate. Tag them as such and add a warning.
- Volume left open at the end means positions are still open. The tester normally closes them with 'end of test', so leftovers are a red flag.
CHECKS (report differences, never hide them):
- sum of round-trip nets + sum of non-trade cash flows == last Balance - 0.
- The count of out, in/out and out by deals equals the DECLARED 'Total Trades:'. MT5 counts closing deals, not FIFO slices: the fixture has 5 closing deals but 6 round trips.
- Deals minus the balance row equals 'Total Deals:'.
- Final Balance - Initial Deposit equals 'Total Net Profit:'.
The recomputed figures are MEASURED; the header statistics are DECLARED.
ENGINE NOTE: parse_trades_csv computes pnl = (exit - entry) * qty, which for lots is in price units, not money. Pass the report's money pnl (as client_pnl or a new field), or infer the per-symbol contract size as median(pnl_gross / ((exit - entry) * dir * lots)).
formats.equity_reconstruction:
- The Balance column is the running account balance after every deal. Verified invariant, with zero mismatches over 445 and 323 deals: Balance[i] = Balance[i-1] + Commission[i] + Swap[i] + Profit[i]. Recompute it and flag any break.
- Balance curve: (Time, Balance) for every row. When several deals share a timestamp, keep the last one.
- Starting point: the 'balance' row, whose value equals 'Initial Deposit:'.
- If more 'balance' or other non-trade rows appear, remove the external flow F_t before computing returns: r_t = (B_t - B_{t-1} - F_t) / B_{t-1}. Pass the engine a flow-adjusted index, because parse_equity_csv uses pct_change on raw equity.
- This is a CLOSED-TRADE balance curve. Floating equity is NOT in the HTML; it exists only as the PNG chart. So an equity drawdown recomputed from this file is NOT_MEASURED, and it understates the true drawdown. The header's 'Equity Drawdown Maximal:' / 'Equity Drawdown Relative:' should be reported as DECLARED.
- Optional true-equity source: the tester Graph tab export 'testergraph.report.*.csv' (UTF-16 with BOM, tab-delimited, header <DATE> <BALANCE> <EQUITY> <DEPOSIT LOAD>, time 'YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM'). This comes from a single public parser, so confidence is LOW.
- Useful DECLARED inputs for red flags: History Quality ('100% real ticks' vs e.g. '25%'), the Period window (for the OOS split), and the number of 'Inputs' rows (free parameters).

formats.export_name: Strategy Tester > Backtest tab > right-click > Report > Open XML (MS Office Excel 2007). The default file is ReportTester-<login>.xlsx.
formats.structure:
MEDIUM confidence. This comes from public parsers; no raw workbook was opened here.
- The workbook has a single worksheet, reported as 'Sheet1'. It is the HTML report laid out as a grid.
- The settings and results labels sit in column A, e.g. 'Initial Deposit:' in col A with the value around col D. One parser reads row[3].
- The cell 'Deals' appears alone in column A. The very next row is the header: Time | Deal | Symbol | Type | Direction | Volume | Price | Order | Commission | Swap | Profit | Balance | Comment.
- Data rows follow. The last row is the totals line, with an empty (None) column A, and must be skipped.
- Volume is reported as stored as a string ('0.17').
- Locate sections by scanning column A for 'Orders' and 'Deals' (localized, as in the HTML). Do not hard-code row numbers.
- Dependency note: openpyxl is NOT in the repo's dependencies. Either add it to an optional extra, or read it with stdlib zipfile + xml.etree (xl/sharedStrings.xml + xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml), treating every cell as text and applying the same number normalizer as the HTML path.
formats.round_trip_reconstruction: Identical to the MT5 tester HTML: FIFO per symbol over the in, out, in/out and out by deals, with 'balance' and other non-buy/sell types treated as cash flows. Cells may be numeric or text, so normalize both (strip spaces and NBSPs as thousands separators). Times may come back as strings 'YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM:SS' or as Excel datetimes. Accept both.
formats.equity_reconstruction: Same as the HTML version. Use the running Balance column, check the invariant Balance[i] = Balance[i-1] + Commission + Swap + Profit, and neutralize non-trade flows. No floating equity is included.

The file has no <meta charset> tag. <meta name="generator" content="client terminal">, <title><login>: <name> - Trade History Report</title>. The CSS defines .hidden { display: none; }.
formats.structure:
VERIFIED against one real report exported 2025.08.13 from a hedging real account. - Everything is in one table, 14 grid columns wide. - Title row:
Trade History Report. - Four header rows use Label:value, with the labels 'Name:', 'Account:', 'Company:' and 'Date:'. - The Account value looks like '123259 (USD, Broker-Server, real, Hedge)'. It holds the currency, server, real/demo, and the margin mode 'Hedge'. The netting spelling is presumably 'Netting' (UNVERIFIED). - The Date value looks like '2025.08.13 23:38'. - Section titles are
Positions
, and likewise for 'Orders' and 'Deals'. 'Open Positions' and 'Working Orders' sections appear only when non-empty (MEDIUM confidence). Each title is followed by a header row . - POSITIONS header, verbatim: Time | Position | Symbol | Type | Volume | Price | S / L | T / P | Time | Price | Commission | Swap | Profit (colspan=2). - 'Time' and 'Price' occur TWICE (open, then close), so map columns by POSITION, never by name. - Every DATA row inserts right after Type, and this cell is NOT in the header. Drop every cell whose class contains 'hidden' before indexing, or the columns shift from the 5th cell on. - Data cells carry class="". - ORDERS header: Open Time | Order | Symbol | Type | Volume | Price | S / L | T / P | Time | State (colspan=2) | Comment (colspan=3). Price is 'market' for market orders. Volume looks like '0.01 / 0.01'. Closing comments look like '[sl 3327.89]' (square brackets in live history). - DEALS header, verbatim: Time | Deal | Symbol | Type | Direction | Volume | Price | Order | Cost () | Commission | Fee | Swap | Profit | Balance | Comment. That is 15 cells, 14 of them visible; every data row also has the hidden Cost cell. - Deposits are Type 'balance' with Comment e.g. 'Depo 3567230'. - The totals row is followed by Commission Fee Swap Profit Balance. Unlike the tester, the Profit total HERE INCLUDES balance rows (observed: 17.63 = deposits 22.20 + trades -4.57). - After the totals come summary rows (Label:v): 'Balance:', 'Free Margin:', 'Credit Facility:', 'Margin:', 'Floating P/L:', 'Margin Level:', 'Equity:'. Then a balance-graph image row. - Then a 'Results' title (...Results) with Total Net Profit:, Gross Profit:, Gross Loss:, Profit Factor:, Expected Payoff:, Recovery Factor:, Sharpe Ratio:, 'Balance Drawdown:', Balance Drawdown Absolute:, Balance Drawdown Maximal:, Balance Drawdown Relative:, Total Trades:, Short Trades (won %):, Long Trades (won %):, Profit Trades (% of total):, Loss Trades (% of total):, Largest profit trade:, Largest loss trade:, Average profit trade:, Average loss trade:, Maximum consecutive wins ($):, Maximum consecutive losses ($):, Maximal consecutive profit (count):, Maximal consecutive loss (count):, Average consecutive wins:, Average consecutive losses:. - LOCATE: find a whose text is 'Positions' or 'Deals' (localized), take the next bgcolor="#E5F0FC" row as the header, and stop at the next or at an empty first cell. - A 'Magic Number' column appears only if the user enabled it in the History tab's column customizer. Treat it as optional.
formats.round_trip_reconstruction:
PREFERRED: use the Positions table, where each row is one closed round trip.
- Fields: entry_time = Time #1, id = Position, side = Type (buy is long, sell is short), qty = Volume (lots), entry_price = Price #1, exit_time = Time #2, exit_price = Price #2.
- net = Commission + Swap + Profit. Profit excludes commission and swap.
- UNVERIFIED: whether Positions.Commission includes both legs (assumed yes), and whether Fee is folded in. Cross-check against Deals.
- UNVERIFIED: for partial closes, the Positions row probably shows the total volume with a volume-weighted close price. If you need the per-slice view, rebuild it from Deals.
CROSS-CHECK or FALLBACK with Deals (verified on the real file):
- The 'in' deal's Order equals the Position ticket.
- The 'out' deal's Order is the CLOSING order's ticket, not the position.
- So under hedging, match each out deal to a Positions row by (symbol, close time, volume). Otherwise fall back to the tester FIFO algorithm (in / out / in/out / out by, with Type as the fill side).
- Two out deals can share a timestamp when several hedged positions close together (observed).
- Deal money net = Commission + Fee + Swap + Profit.
- Types other than buy and sell (balance, credit, and presumably dividend or commission rows; ramtraderbook saw dividend and 'tax ref.' rows) are cash flows, not trades.
- Open positions at report time are listed separately. Exclude them from closed-trade metrics and mention them.
- CHECK: sum(Positions net) == 'Total Net Profit:' (DECLARED) and == the net of trade deals (MEASURED).
formats.equity_reconstruction:
- The Deals Balance column is the running balance. The invariant is Balance[i] = Balance[i-1] + Commission + Fee + Swap + Profit; the hidden Cost column is not added (ASSUMPTION; it was empty in the sample).
- The report may cover a sub-period (the user picks a History period), so the first row need not be a deposit. Take the starting balance as Balance[0] - (Commission + Fee + Swap + Profit)[0].
- Deposits and withdrawals are frequent in live accounts, so compute flow-adjusted returns r_t = (B_t - B_{t-1} - F_t) / B_{t-1}, where F_t = Profit of non-buy/sell rows.
- Floating equity is only the final 'Equity:' snapshot. Tag equity-curve drawdown NOT_MEASURED, and tag the balance-curve metrics as MEASURED from the file.
- Times are server time with no timezone.

formats.export_name: Toolbox > History tab > right-click > Report > Open XML (MS Office Excel 2007). The default file is ReportHistory-<login>.xlsx.
formats.structure:
MEDIUM confidence. This comes from three public parsers; no workbook was opened here.
- One sheet.
- Rows 1-5: 'Trade History Report', then 'Name:', 'Account:' (value like '4000084439 (USD, Darwinex-Live, real, Hedge)'), 'Company:', 'Date:' ('2026.03.02 19:09').
- Stacked sections, each introduced by a column-A cell: 'Positions', 'Orders', 'Deals', optional 'Open Positions' / 'Working Orders', and 'Results'. The header row comes immediately after the title.
- Positions columns, A..M: Time | Position | Symbol | Type | Volume | Price | S / L | T / P | Time | Price | Commission | Swap | Profit. Time and Price are duplicated.
- Deals: Time | Deal | Symbol | Type | Direction | Volume | Price | Order | [Cost] | Commission | Fee | Swap | Profit | Balance | Comment. Cost may be present as a hidden column (UNVERIFIED).
- Volume is a string.
- Detect sections by column-A text; never by fixed row numbers.
- Reading it needs openpyxl (not a current dependency) or stdlib zipfile + xml.
formats.round_trip_reconstruction: Same as the HTML history report. Prefer Positions rows as closed round trips, map columns by position because of the duplicate Time and Price, and set net = Commission + Swap + Profit. Deals are for cross-checking and for cash flows (balance, dividend, tax, and similar rows).
formats.equity_reconstruction: Same as the HTML history report: use the Deals Balance column with flow-adjusted returns. The starting balance is Balance[0] minus the first row's own flows.

formats.export_name: Strategy Tester > Report or Results tab > right-click > 'Save as Report'. The default file is StrategyTester.htm, with the chart StrategyTester.gif saved next to it; the img src uses the same base name.
formats.file_type: .htm. Single-byte ANSI in the Windows code page (Windows-1252 on Western systems), with no BOM and no charset meta. DOCTYPE HTML 4.01 Strict, <meta name="generator" content="MetaQuotes Software Corp.">, <meta name="version" content="Build 1090">, <meta name="server" content="...">. Decode as UTF-8 strict first, then fall back to cp1252.
formats.structure:
VERIFIED against real reports from builds 1090 and 1408. - Title:
Strategy Tester Report
, then divs for the EA name and ' (Build NNNN)'. - TABLE 1 (width=820): label/value cells. Rows with colspan=2 label + colspan=4 value carry 'Symbol', 'Period' (e.g. '1 Hour (H1) 2010.01.03 22:00 - 2017.08.25 20:59 (2010.01.01 - 2017.08.27)'), 'Model' and 'Parameters' ('A=1; B=2; '). - Model is one of 'Every tick (the most precise method based on all available least timeframes to generate each tick)', 'Control points ...' or 'Open prices only (only for Expert Advisors that explicitly control bar opening)'. Low-precision models are wrapped in . - Then pair rows Labelvalue with these labels, verbatim and with no colons: Bars in test, Ticks modelled, Modelling quality ('n/a' or '90.00%'), Mismatched charts errors, Initial deposit, Spread, Total net profit, Gross profit, Gross loss (negative), Profit factor, Expected payoff, Absolute drawdown, Maximal drawdown ('1171.16 (40.27%)'), Relative drawdown ('47.96% (1163.96)'), Total trades, Short positions (won %), Long positions (won %), Profit trades (% of total), Loss trades (% of total). - Split-label rows put 'Largest', 'Average', 'Maximum', 'Maximal' or 'Average' in a colspan=2 cell, followed by 'profit trade' / 'loss trade', 'consecutive wins (profit in money)' / 'consecutive losses (loss in money)', 'consecutive profit (count of wins)' / 'consecutive loss (count of losses)', or 'consecutive wins' / 'consecutive losses'. - Then . - TABLE 2: header row , verbatim: # | Time | Type | Order | Size | Price | S / L | T / P | Profit | Balance. Rows alternate bgcolor="#E0E0E0". - Rows that open or modify an order end with , i.e. 9 cells. Close rows fill Profit and Balance, i.e. 10 cells. - Cells carry class=msdate on Time, class=mspt on Size, Profit and Balance, and style="mso-number-format:0\.00000;" on prices. - LOCATE: the table whose header row's cells are exactly ['#','Time','Type','Order','Size','Price','S / L','T / P','Profit','Balance'], or structurally the bgcolor="#C0C0C0" row with 10 cells. Localized label text is UNVERIFIED.
formats.round_trip_reconstruction:
CELL VALUES
- Time is 'YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM' (NO seconds), in server time.
- Numbers have no thousands separator in the tester (verified), e.g. '2000.00'. Still strip whitespace defensively.
- Type values OBSERVED in real files: buy, sell, modify, close, t/p, s/l, 'close at stop'.
- Documented but NOT observed in samples: buy limit, sell limit, buy stop, sell stop (pending placed), delete (pending removed), close by.
- 'close at stop' means the tester force-closed the position at the END of the test, not a stop-loss. Keep it, but flag the trade as forced (it resembles MT5's 'end of test').
ALGORITHM: group rows by the Order column (the ticket).
- Entry: the first 'buy' or 'sell' row of the ticket. Its Price is the entry price and its Time the entry time; side = long for buy, short for sell. A pending order placed as 'buy limit' etc. and later filled appears as a 'buy'/'sell' row with the same Order (MEDIUM confidence).
- 'modify' rows only change S / L or T / P. Ignore them for P&L, but they can be counted.
- Exit: every row of that ticket whose Type is in {close, t/p, s/l, close at stop, close by}. Its Price is the exit price, Size the closed lots, and Profit the realized money P&L.
- Profit is NET: the verified invariant is Balance[i] = Balance[i-1] + Profit[i] with 0 mismatches over 163 closes, so swap and commission are already included and there are no separate columns.
- Tickets with only pending-type rows plus 'delete' are cancelled orders, not trades.
- PARTIAL CLOSE: in MT4 the remainder gets a NEW ticket (comment 'from #old'), and the tester's rendering of that is UNVERIFIED.
  - If a close row references an Order with no preceding entry row, do not guess. Link it only if exactly one earlier ticket has unclosed volume equal to the row's Size, and emit a warning.
  - Otherwise count the row as an unpairable close. Its money Profit still counts toward the balance, but the entry is NOT_MEASURED.
- CHECKS: the count of close-type rows vs the DECLARED 'Total trades'; Initial deposit + sum(Profit) vs the last Balance and 'Total net profit'.
formats.equity_reconstruction:
- The Balance column appears only on close rows. The curve is the Initial deposit (from the header) at the test start, taken from the 'Period' range or the first row time, followed by (Time, Balance) at each close row.
- It is a closed-trade balance; floating equity is not in the file, so any equity drawdown is NOT_MEASURED.
- The header's Absolute, Maximal and Relative drawdown are DECLARED. MT4 computes them on equity when the model allows.
- There are no deposits beyond the initial one, so simple pct_change on balance is valid.
- DECLARED red-flag inputs: Model ('Open prices only' or 'Control points' are low precision), Modelling quality ('n/a' or < 90%), Mismatched charts errors > 0, Spread ('Current' vs fixed), and the Parameters string (count of free parameters).

formats.export_name: Terminal > Account History tab. Pick the period with right-click > 'All History' or 'Custom Period', then right-click > 'Save as Report' (Statement.htm) or 'Save as Detailed Report' (DetailedStatement.htm, which adds a DetailedStatement.gif balance chart and a 'Details:' statistics block).
formats.file_type: .htm. Single-byte ANSI with no BOM and no charset meta. Decode UTF-8 strict first, then cp1252. The terminal fills it from its own template, templates/StatementDetailed.htm, whose placeholders include <!--CLOSED_POSITIONS--> and <!--BALANCE-->.
formats.structure:
VERIFIED against the MT4 template and two real statements (2017 and 2025). - Statement: <account> - <name>, then the company name in a 20pt div. - A single table . - First row: 'Account: N', 'Name: X', 'Currency: USD', 'Leverage: 1:200', and the report time '2017 October 25, 11:29'. Each is a . - Section-title rows: , 'Open Trades:', 'Working Orders:', 'Summary:', and (detailed only) 'Details:'. - Header rows are . CLOSED TRANSACTIONS header, verbatim: Ticket | Open Time | Type | Size | Item | Price | S / L | T / P | Close Time | Price | Commission | Taxes | Swap | Profit (14 cells; 'Price' appears twice). - Trade rows, 14 cells: ... The symbol ('Item') is lower-case. - The order COMMENT is only in the title attribute of the Ticket cell, e.g. '[tp]', '[sl]', '#16384 My order[tp]', 'from #123', 'to #456'. Read that attribute. - Non-trade rows: Type 'balance' or 'credit' + + , which is 4 cells. - Cancelled pending orders: Type 'buy limit' / 'sell stop' ..., with close time and price but instead of the money cells (title="cancelled"). - The section ends with a totals row ( + Commission, Taxes, Swap and Profit sums, excluding balance rows) and then 'Closed P/L:' (Commission + Swap + Profit + Taxes). - An empty section shows . - Open Trades header: same as closed, but the 9th header cell is blank ( ) and the 10th Price is the current price. Working Orders: Ticket | Open Time | Type | Size | Item | Price | S / L | T / P | Market Price (colspan=2). - Summary labels, verbatim: Deposit/Withdrawal:, Credit Facility:, Closed Trade P/L:, Floating P/L:, Margin:, Balance:, Equity:, Free Margin:. - Details labels (detailed only): Gross Profit:, Gross Loss: (POSITIVE number here, unlike the tester), Total Net Profit:, Profit Factor:, Expected Payoff:, Absolute Drawdown:, Maximal Drawdown:, Relative Drawdown:, Total Trades:, Short Positions (won %):, Long Positions (won %):, Profit Trades (% of total):, Loss trades (% of total):, Largest profit trade: / loss trade:, Average profit trade: / loss trade:, Maximum consecutive wins ($): / consecutive losses ($):, Maximal consecutive profit (count): / consecutive loss (count):, Average consecutive wins: / consecutive losses:. - LOCATE: the row whose first cell text is 'Closed Transactions:', then the bgcolor="#C0C0C0" header, then read rows until the totals row (first cell has colspan=10 and is empty) or 'Closed P/L:'. - Numbers use a SPACE thousands separator ('100 100.00', verified 0x20). Times are 'YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM:SS'.
...
Closed Transactions:
ticket2017.10.06 09:56:55buy0.10usdnokcommentamountcancelled No transactions
formats.round_trip_reconstruction:
- Each 14-cell row with Type buy or sell in 'Closed Transactions:' is already one closed round trip: entry_time = Open Time, entry_price = Price #1, exit_time = Close Time, exit_price = Price #2, qty = Size (lots), side = Type (buy is long, sell is short), symbol = Item.
- net = Commission + Taxes + Swap + Profit. Profit is gross. This is verified: the totals row reconciles with 'Closed P/L:'.
- Skip cancelled pending rows (the colspan=4 'cancelled' cell). Keep 'balance' and 'credit' rows as cash flows.
- PARTIAL CLOSES: MT4 closes the partial volume under the original ticket, with comment 'to #NEW' in the title attribute. The remainder becomes a new ticket with comment 'from #OLD', carrying the ORIGINAL open time and open price. So every row stays a valid round trip for P&L, but holding time for the remainder is measured from the original open. Link the pieces by parsing '#(\d+)' from the title, and do not double count.
- Rows are ordered roughly by open time. Sort by Close Time for sequencing.
- CHECKS: the sum of nets equals 'Closed P/L:' and 'Closed Trade P/L:'. The count of trade rows equals the DECLARED 'Total Trades:'.
formats.equity_reconstruction:
- Balance curve: sort trade rows by Close Time and balance or credit rows by their Open Time, then B_t = B_start + cumulative(net of trades) + cumulative(balance-row amounts).
- EXCLUDE 'credit' rows from the balance. Verified: Balance: 105 899.96 = Deposit/Withdrawal 100 100.00 + Closed Trade P/L 5 799.96, while the credit of 50 020.00 is reported separately under Credit Facility and adds only to Equity.
- If the user exported a custom period, the file may not start with the initial deposit. Then B_start = Summary 'Balance:' - 'Deposit/Withdrawal:' - 'Closed Trade P/L:'; tag that value DECLARED because it comes from summary arithmetic.
- Use flow-adjusted returns around deposits and withdrawals.
- Floating equity exists only as the end-of-period 'Equity:' and 'Floating P/L:' values, so the equity-curve drawdown is NOT_MEASURED. The 'Maximal Drawdown' in Details is DECLARED.

formats.platform: MetaTrader 5 - Strategy Tester optimization results (SpreadsheetML XML), extra: gives the true number of trials
formats.export_name: Strategy Tester > Optimization Results tab > right-click > Export to XML (MS Office Excel). The default file is ReportOptimizer-<login>.xml.
formats.file_type: .xml in Excel 2003 SpreadsheetML (<?mso-application progid="Excel.Sheet"?>, namespace urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet). Reported as UTF-8, sometimes UTF-16, so auto-detect the BOM.
formats.structure:
MEDIUM confidence, from two public parsers.
- A <DocumentProperties> block carries run metadata: title (EA, symbol, period, dates), deposit, leverage, server and build.
- One worksheet named 'Tester Optimizator Results', with one <Row> per optimization pass.
- Header cells, verbatim: Pass | Result | Profit | Expected Payoff | Profit Factor | Recovery Factor | Sharpe Ratio | Custom | Equity DD % | Trades, followed by one column per optimized input parameter.
- Parse it with stdlib xml.etree using the ss: namespace.
formats.round_trip_reconstruction: Not applicable: there are no trades, only a per-pass summary. Its audit value is that the number of rows (passes) is a MEASURED count of the trials behind the chosen configuration. Use it to replace or check the client's DECLARED 'trials' in the DSR. The spread of Result or Profit across passes can also be reported as a descriptive overfitting signal. It cannot feed CSCV/PBO, because per-period returns are absent.
formats.equity_reconstruction: Not available. Per-pass summary statistics only.
